more_info.overview: 1,4-Heptonolactone is a hydroxyl-containing lactone, a cyclic ester related to a seven-carbon sugar acid. The compound record describes a five-membered oxygen-containing ring with several hydroxyl groups. This chemical identity distinguishes it from glucono-delta-lactone. The historical entry assigns an acidity-regulating role, but a particular commercial food preparation and typical current food examples were not confirmed.
